name: Westinghouse WTM3100WL-X 312L top mount fridge
summary: A smaller white top-mount option with 238L fresh-food and 74L freezer capacity. Its 598mm body and specified side gaps suit a narrower opening than the larger fridges here. It trades capacity for a compact footprint; check corner access before choosing it.
specification: Exact WTM3100WL-X Australian page: 312L total, 238L fridge and 74L freezer; 598 W × 1646 H × 650 D mm; frost free, manual ice tray, optional door-reversal kit. Two-year domestic warranty. No extension from another model carried over.
installation: Visually inspected Nov24 dimension sheet linked from exact suffix page: WTM3100WL family, 30mm each side, 90mm above, 50mm behind; 1199mm depth at 90-degree opening; 350mm hinge-side corner space for shelf removal. Doors project beyond cabinetry. 658mm is width only, not a complete cavity specification.
feedback: Read ten rendered entries and individual JSON-LD reviews; three identical anonymous two-star empty reviews counted once and no cause inferred. Distinct owners Maree, Fran and Di praise useful storage in a small fridge; Di dislikes the open meat shelf. Recent owners praise freshness/value. Empty reviews and AI summary excluded from thematic findings; possible incentives and limited long-term evidence.
drawbacks: The 598mm body needs 30mm at each side, 90mm above and 50mm behind in the dimension drawing. A 658mm width check does not guarantee complete fit.
Near a corner wall, allow the specified 350mm hinge-side space for shelf removal. The doors project beyond cabinetry; door reversal needs an optional kit and correct fitting.
The freezer is only 74L. Large batch-cooking households may need more capacity; fresh-food access involves bending.
An owner dislikes the open meat shelf. The small review sample and possible incentives do not establish long-term reliability.
suits: A smaller household needing a narrower top-freezer fridge with useful fresh-food storage
A kitchen that provides the full ventilation and door-opening space
mayNotSuit: Large frozen-food loads or a flush cabinet installation
A tight corner without the specified hinge-side door access

compare.reason: A narrower top-freezer option: 238L fridge and 74L freezer capacity.
compare.tradeoff: Allow 90mm above and 50mm behind. A corner needs 350mm hinge-side access for shelf removal. Smaller freezer; optional kit for door reversal.

name: Westinghouse WSF6602XC 60cm dishwasher
summary: A simpler full-width alternative with 14 place settings, six programs and a lower cutlery basket. Consider it when the delivered price matters more than a separate cutlery drawer. Check panel legibility and rack fit in person; owner feedback includes service complaints as well as praise for everyday cleaning.
specification: Exact Australian model: 598 W × 845 H × 598 D mm, 14 place settings, six programs, 47dBA, lower cutlery basket and upper knife shelf, height-adjustable upper basket, FastDry. Two-year domestic warranty. No third cutlery drawer claim. No consumption claim based on conflicting cached listing values.
installation: Visually inspected Aug25 WSF6602XC dimension sheet: cut-out 600 W × 850 H × 580 D mm, body 598 W × 845 H × 598 D, open-door depth 1175mm. 580mm is the cut-out drawing depth, not total appliance depth or flush-installation promise. Installer must verify projection, services and worktop arrangement.
feedback: Ten displayed entries inspected individually. Dianne, Anthony and Belinda praise operation, quick cycle and cleaning/value. Helen reports a hard-to-read panel and a leak needing adjustment. Gerry reports early dissatisfaction and delayed service. Excluded an oven review and store-credit complaint; Edwin names an Electrolux dishwasher, so excluded from exact-model fault evidence. Possible incentives, contamination and limited sample mean no reliability rate inferred.
drawbacks: Uses a lower cutlery basket and upper knife shelf, not a full third cutlery drawer. Check bulky pots and tall glasses against the actual racks.
The manufacturer drawing specifies a 600 × 850 × 580mm cut-out; the 598mm-deep body projects farther. Allow 1175mm open-door depth plus standing room and service space.

Individual feedback includes a hard-to-read panel, a leak requiring adjustment and a complaint about early problems and delayed service. Other owners praise everyday cleaning; this is not a proven reliability upgrade.
The stated operating noise is 47dBA. Check suitability for an open-plan room and compare the full delivered and installed quote.
suits: A standard-width replacement where a simpler basket layout and lower upfront price are priorities
A kitchen that meets the exact installation drawing and service requirements
mayNotSuit: Buyers wanting a full third cutlery drawer or matching cabinet door
Those prioritising proven long-term reliability over initial price

compare.reason: A simpler 14-place full-width option with six programs and a lower cutlery basket.
compare.tradeoff: No full third cutlery drawer. Allow 1175mm open-door depth. Mixed owner feedback includes panel-legibility and service complaints.

manualReview.finding: 850mm cut-out is for complete appliance; manual 820mm underbench drawing follows removal of the top. No unqualified 820mm-fit claim. Two-year domestic warranty verified.
